caption: Pre-declared acceptance criteria evaluated against committed study-05 evidence. INFLAM-01/02 pass: the BioGears engine and the SBML extraction agree on minimum tissue integrity (rel err 0.0044%) and peak blood pathogen (0.12%), within a 1% tolerance. HEMO-01 fails: time to septic shock (MAP < 65 mmHg) differs by 15.3 h (engine 69.3 h vs SBML 54.1 h), outside the 6 h tolerance — consistent with the known hemodynamic divergence. SURR-01 is pending: the surrogate clinical-accuracy validator is declared but not yet run. Each verdict links to its evidence artifact; the pending gate is reported honestly rather than silently passed.
